summary.name: Chatsonic
summary.one_liner: Chatsonic is a marketing-focused AI chat platform that combines models such as GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini with tools like WordPress and Google Search Console.
use_cases: Researching marketing topics with real-time web data
Drafting and editing marketing content with a canvas
Pulling performance data from Google Search Console
Analyzing marketing data and generating reports
Maintaining a consistent brand voice across content
summary.what_it_does: Chatsonic is a chat interface that lets users switch between OpenAI models (GPT-4o and o1), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Flux 1.1 within one conversation. It connects to marketing tools such as WordPress, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics to pull data and publish content. The page describes a canvas feature for collaborative writing and coding, and the ability to create and preview web pages, presentations, and diagrams in chat. It also offers brand voice customization for tone and style guidelines, and it claims to analyze data and produce reports from chat prompts.
notable: Multiple leading AI models (GPT-4o, o1, Claude, Gemini, Flux 1.1) in one chat
Direct integrations with WordPress, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics
Canvas feature for collaborative writing and coding
caveats: Paid Individual plan listed at $16 billed annually; advanced marketing capabilities require upgrading
Integrations are described as available for specific platforms; others are only loosely mentioned as 'and more'
Cloud-based only; requires an internet connection
